name: DLP Policies Cover Exchange and SharePoint/OneDrive

impactRating.rationale: Failure to apply DLP policies across Exchange and SharePoint exposes the tenant to: Undetected exfiltration of regulated data (PII, financial records, health information) via email attachments and file sharing without policy enforcement.

Failure to configure auto-sensitivity labeling policies exposes the tenant to: Sensitive data stored without classification labels, bypassing DLP controls and encryption policies that depend on label presence for enforcement.

Failure to enable communication compliance monitoring exposes the tenant to: Regulatory violations, insider trading activity, and hostile workplace communications going undetected without policy-based surveillance of internal messaging.

name: Ensure MX records exist and point to Exchange Online for all email domains

impactRating.rationale: Failure to route email through Exchange Online mail flow exposes the tenant to: Security control bypass; mail not traversing Exchange Online skips ATP scanning, DLP policies, mail flow rules, and anti-phishing defenses.
Informational: surfaces the total count of disabled member accounts alongside total directory size. High ratios may indicate accounts pending removal or an offboarding gap.

nist-800-53.title: Wireless Access; Session Authenticity; Remote Access

soc2.title: Logical Access Security Software, Infrastructure, and Architectures; Restriction of Access to System Boundaries; Prevention and Detection of Unauthorized Software

impactRating.rationale: This heuristic flags enabled inbound connectors where TLS is not required and sender-domain/IP restrictions are absent. Review the connector's intended use and sender scope. A pass means no connector matched this heuristic; it does not independently prove that tenant-wide Direct Send is blocked.

name: Periodic Reauthentication Required for All Users

impactRating.rationale: Without periodic reauthentication, session tokens remain valid indefinitely until explicitly revoked. Stolen or leaked tokens provide durable access that survives credential rotation.
Trusted named locations are required building blocks for exclusionary geographic access controls and location-scoped Conditional Access policies.
Without a block policy that excludes trusted locations, authentication from unexpected geographies proceeds unchallenged, enabling credential-stuffing and session-hijack follow-through.

name: Token Protection Enabled for Sign-in Sessions

impactRating.rationale: Token protection binds session tokens to the device that requested them, preventing theft and replay of primary refresh tokens on attacker infrastructure.
Authentication transfer allows moving credentials between devices during sign-in. Blocking it prevents cookie-banner and QR-based credential relay attacks.
Allowing self-service Microsoft 365 group creation leads to ungoverned collaboration workspaces with default sharing settings, expanding the data-exposure surface.
Unrestricted application password addition allows long-lived shared secrets to proliferate across app and service principal credentials, complicating rotation and increasing breach blast radius.

name: Application Password Lifetime Limited to 180 Days

impactRating.rationale: Application passwords with unlimited lifetime act as permanent credentials. Capping lifetime forces regular rotation and limits the window of exposure for leaked secrets.
Custom (user-defined) application passwords bypass system entropy requirements and are more susceptible to guessing and reuse across systems.

name: Application Certificate Lifetime Limited to 180 Days

impactRating.rationale: Long-lived application certificates delay detection of compromised credentials and complicate incident response when key material is exposed.

name: Smart Lockout Duration at Least 60 Seconds

impactRating.rationale: A zero or near-zero lockout duration allows immediate retry after lockout, enabling rapid password-guessing campaigns against the same account.
Companion applications can receive Authenticator push approvals outside the primary Authenticator app, expanding the prompt-fatigue and approval-relay attack surface.
Without DLP policies published to Copilot experiences, sensitive data can be surfaced and shared through AI-assisted interactions without the controls applied to traditional workloads.

name: OWA Personal Email Accounts and Calendars Blocked

impactRating.rationale: Allowing personal email accounts and calendars in Outlook on the web enables unmonitored data flow between corporate and consumer identities, bypassing DLP and audit controls.
